text: Misspelled columns: the post creation date is posts.CreaionDate and the last activity date is posts.LasActivityDate.
posts.PostTypeId 1 = question (has Title, Tags, AcceptedAnswerId), 2 = answer, whose posts.ParentId is the question's Id; root posts have ParentId NULL.
posts.Tags is a string like '<bayesian><prior>' ('<humor>' for a single tag); tags.TagName holds the bare tag ('bayesian').
A user's name is users.DisplayName; posts.OwnerUserId, posts.LastEditorUserId, comments.UserId, badges.UserId and votes.UserId refer to users.Id.
When posts.OwnerUserId is NULL, posts.OwnerDisplayName holds the owner's name.
postHistory.Text is the revision content: PostHistoryTypeId 1/4 = title, 2/5 = body, 3/6 = tags (initial/edit). postHistory.UserId is the user who made that revision.
Posts related to a user can be found through posts.OwnerUserId (owner) or through postHistory.UserId joined on postHistory.PostId = posts.Id (users who created or edited them).
Popularity of a post is posts.ViewCount; how valuable it is, posts.FavoriteCount. A post with posts.ClosedDate NOT NULL is 'well-finished'; NULL means not well-finished.
comments.Score above 60 means a positive comment; below 60 a negative comment.
users.Age groups: teenager = 13-18, adult = 19-65, elder = over 65. A user's influence is users.Reputation.
